title: Audit the public experimental lab and money-flow lineage without publishing financial, chain, authority, or deployment claims
reason: PR 192 combines a stale public dashboard and homepage banner with a Pages workflow that has pages:write, id-token:write, workflow_dispatch release selection, and production deployment capability. Its dashboard contains an unattested historical BSC snapshot, balances, pending entitlement, money-flow, payroll, ATM, resource, approval-gate, actor-address, and governance candidates that must not be published as current facts. Current main has a newer safer Pages path and intentionally lacks the dashboard. The only safe bounded task is an evidence-only lineage audit that changes no candidate UI, workflow, Runtime, financial data, Canon, CURRENT, authority, deployment, or pull-request state.

inventory.security_blocker: PR 192 publication and financial-governance candidates cannot be transplanted or activated without current trusted provenance, exact Human authority, current-main redesign, and exact-head security and product validation.

The candidate Pages workflow grants pages:write and id-token:write and exposes workflow_dispatch inputs that can select a release ref; this run is not authorized to merge or dispatch such a workflow.
The candidate workflow uses older checkout and Pages action generations than current main and would regress the current exact-head PR validation and main-only production deployment design.

The BSC block 118743165 snapshot is explicitly unattested, historical, not independently verified, and not repository-bound evidence of current balances, supply, burn, entitlement, deployment, settlement, custody, or authority.

The rejected historical Pages attempt stopped before deployment and is not proof that the candidate was published.
Current main intentionally retains the pre-dashboard homepage and dashboard absence; the six public UI and documentation blobs match the merge base rather than the audited head.

Do not add workflow_dispatch, release-ref selection, pages:write, id-token:write, deployment, or workflow-dispatch behavior without exact side-effect-specific Human authorization.
Require repository-bound, independently verifiable, time-bounded provenance for any chain snapshot and label historical observations by exact chain, block, hash, source, and verification status.

Do not present balances, supply, burn, entitlement, payroll, ATM, reward, resource, treasury, market, approval, actor, address, controller, signer, reviewer, governance, or settlement candidates as true or current without authoritative evidence.

If a public read-only successor is separately authorized, rebuild it inside the current shell, remove protected action controls, preserve fail-closed labeling, and pass exact-head security, functional Chromium, Responsive, and direct 390x844 screenshot inspection.
